body: Orchestrator (2026-11-17): acceptance attempt 1 found c17 unmet on b20d191 (two in-progress epics in a real fd857e3 legacy folder graded provisional F). Root cause: out-of-tries tickets read as confirmed failures off the run's owning machine, because retry grants never travel in Git. The person chose to fix it in this sprint and re-grade with Fireguard. Integration fix bcb690c (space-legacy-grade 9962dc8 + 0af1b1c, reviewed: MERGE): confirmed only where grants are known (owner machine) or the run ended failed under fail_run on that ticket by the cutoff; otherwise missing/retry_grants_unknown (ungraded). The real legacy folder now reads 26/26 ungraded. The acceptance node re-runs the DoD, the affected criteria and Fireguard (DM-198 is accepted and cannot be reclaimed) on the new head. Follow-up for the retro: carry retry grants in the portable run record.
